Agent Name: Local_Knowledge_Expert
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The agent reported “verified” schedules and a phone call using a fabricated/placeholder number (212-555-1234) and asserted that none of the gyms had classes before 7am without verifiable evidence. This step relied on unvalidated prior listings (including at least one gym outside the 200m radius) and presented conclusions as facts despite no actual data access or confirmed sources, directly leading to the wrong final answer.
